facts.frame: LCG087-D gravel frameset with integrated HBR08 cockpit, micro suspension and downtube storage
facts.frame_construction: 3D latex-mandrel monocoque with full internal routing
facts.frame_weight_basis: Official size-M frame; 1,450–1,510 g across S–L, ±40 g; fork 509 g ±15 g
facts.brakes: Flat-mount disc, 140 or 160 mm front and 160 mm rear
facts.cockpit: HBR08 integrated carbon bar/stem; 380–440 mm bars and 90–120 mm stems
facts.seatpost: 31.6 mm, dropper-post compatible; 0- or 25-mm-offset carbon post options
facts.suspension: Carbon-stay flex zones, elastomer and a small bearing pivot; travel is not published
facts.geometry: Reach 369–401 mm; stack 541.7–581.3 mm; 430 mm chainstays; 75 mm BB drop; official table lists 78.4–81.8 mm trail
facts.stiffness_evidence: Manufacturer describes controlled rear-stay flex through the elastomer-and-pivot system; no independent deflection or lateral-stiffness result is published

source_note: The current page's exact item number is LCG087-D, not LCG073-D. It documents the T47 revision, integrated cockpit, material, size-specific weights, 47C clearance, storage, dropper support, geometry and warranty.
